sections.text: The Data Governance Committee (DGC) may grant exceptions to data sharing restrictions on a case-by-case basis, subject to the conditions and process defined herein.

DGC Exception Request Process: Step 1 - Submit DGC Exception Request Form (Form DGC-EXC-01) to governance@company.com with business justification and risk assessment. Step 2 - DGC reviews request within 10 business days at bi-weekly meeting. Step 3 - Legal department provides compliance review within 5 business days. Step 4 - Chief Data Officer provides final written approval or denial. Step 5 - Approved exceptions are logged in the Exception Registry with a 12-month validity period.
DGC exceptions are time-limited and must be renewed annually. Renewal requests must be submitted 30 days before expiry.
Exceptions may not be granted for policies explicitly marked as non-waivable (i.e., policies containing the phrase 'This restriction may not be waived').
Non-waivable policy means any policy section containing the explicit phrase: 'This restriction may not be waived.' Such restrictions cannot be overridden even by the DGC or CDO.
